purpose: Teach: 亡くなら/戦わ/誤認/下回っ/採掘/投棄/抄/癒着

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さん、本気で、絶対、亡くなられた時、本気で、医師として、絶対、辛い時間、本気で、本当に、絶対、感謝、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Ren, when a patient passes away, it's genuinely difficult as a physician. I'm truly grateful for your understanding.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Pause after his name. Quiet weight on 'difficult'—not avoiding it, just acknowledging it plainly. Slight exhale before gratitude. Clear but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療従事者、本気で、絶対、戦われている毎日、絶対、頭が下がります、先生、本気で、本当に、感謝
lines.en: Healthcare workers fight so hard every single day. I have deep respect for you, Doctor. Thank you for what you do.
lines.style: Sincere, unhurried. Slight breath before 'fight.' Genuine weight on respect—not flattery, just honest. Eyes up. Slower tempo. Trailing softly into gratitude.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。誤認診断、本気で、絶対、避けるよう、医師、本気で、慎重に、診察してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I work carefully every day to avoid misdiagnosis. Thank you for your trust in that.
lines.style: Calm, professional. Slight nod in the voice. Matter-of-fact on clinical detail, warm on the closing. Not defensive—just steady commitment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今年の患者数、本気で、絶対、昨年を、下回ったとのこと、本気で、医療界、絶対、嬉しいですね、先生、本気で、本当に、絶対、感謝。
lines.en: I'm glad to hear patient numbers dropped this year. It suggests the medical field is making real progress.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the start. Genuine curiosity underneath—not small talk. Quiet lift on 'progress.' Warm but grounded. Like he's thinking aloud with someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。新薬の元素、本気で、絶対、採掘から、絶対、関わる重要な、研究、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're advancing crucial research into new medications right from the mining of their base elements. It's important work.
lines.style: Clear, informative but not lecturing. Slight emphasis on 'crucial' and 'important'—conviction without showiness. Measured pace. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療廃棄物の投棄、本気で、絶対、社会問題ですよね、先生、本気で、本当に、慎重に、絶対、処理、必要ですよね、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Medical waste disposal is a serious social issue, isn't it, Doctor? It requires careful, responsible handling at every step.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Not rhetorical—genuinely thinking with her. Careful articulation on 'responsible.' Slower pace. Sincere without being heavy.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。診療記録の抄録、本気で、絶対、患者さんに、絶対、開示しております、本気で、本当に、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We share patient records with our patients—transparency is essential to building trust in healthcare.
lines.style: Direct, clear. Slight emphasis on 'transparency.' Professional but warm. Not defensive about disclosure—just straightforward about what's right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療と製薬業界の癒着、本気で、絶対、ないこと、市民、本気で、絶対、信じております、感謝
lines.en: I believe most people trust that healthcare and pharmaceutical industries operate independently. That trust is important to maintain.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slightly longer pause before speaking. Hopeful but grounded—not naive, just earnest. Soft close, like settling on something difficult but necessary to believe in.
